name: (01) Daimoinon — 1 Basic — Fear of the Void

system.description: You must have used Sense the Sin on a target earlier in the scene. Speak in low syllables and engage all desired targets in a mass Social Challenge; for each Trait bid in the earlier Sense the Sin beyond the first, the victim must bid an additional Trait. Anyone who loses must bid one additional Trait per Trait bid in Sense the Sin on all challenges for the rest of the scene.
system.prerequisites: Requires Sense the Sin used on the same target(s) earlier in the scene
